title: Los Alamos insider: their propulsion systems are grown

tellings.quote: Well, I had one guy just say, "Well, I can Their propulsion systems are not built. They're grown."

plain: Someone connected to Los Alamos, the US government weapons laboratory in New Mexico, is said to have claimed that the engines of non-human craft are not built but grown. A guest named Mario Woods relays this from a man he does not name, quoting him as saying: "Their propulsion systems are not built. They're grown." If true, it would mean the craft are made by something closer to biology than to engineering.
